notable_patterns: Page Object Model (POM) pattern with separation of verification and action flows
Consistent use of wait_for_object with configurable timeout and raise_e parameters
JavaScript executor used for clicking hidden elements (click_close_button)
Keyboard interaction using Selenium Keys for page refresh (Ctrl+R)
Alpha/workaround code documented inline for Windows dummy printer functionality
Multi-screen popup navigation pattern for onboarding flow (What's New popup)
Duplicate method definitions (click_hpx_whats_new_popup_next_btn and click_hpx_whats_new_popup_back_btn appear multiple times)
Verification methods use invisible flag to confirm logged-in state
String-based locator identifiers passed to driver methods rather than explicit locator variables
Consistent naming convention: verify_* for assertions, click_* for actions, get_* for data retrieval

summaries.file_summary: DevicesMFE page class extends SmartFlow and provides comprehensive test automation methods for HP Smart Devices MFE (Micro Frontend) web interface. Contains 31 methods organized into verification flows and action flows, supporting device management, popup handling, navigation verification, and multi-screen onboarding workflows. Notable for alpha code workarounds, JavaScript-based element interaction, and keyboard-driven page refresh functionality.
